failure_summary.description: Numeric parameter values were emitted as JSON numbers instead of the required strings.
Calls used shortened or invented tool names rather than the exact identifiers in the available-tools list.
Explicit operations described as earlier workflow steps were omitted from the calls.
A marketplace hostname was passed where the expected value was its canonical marketplace code.

patch.reasoning: These recurring failures are already directly covered by the skill: it requires string serialization, exact full tool identifiers, actionable treatment of narrated workflow steps, and canonical marketplace codes. No additional edit would address a genuine documentation gap without duplicating existing guidance.
